remarks: This country cottage with modern flairs provides privacy and convenience just minutes from downtown New Canaan or South Wilton center. Located in the desirable Valley Road Neighborhood, this 4-bedroom 2-bath home is nestled on 3.3 acres of private land overlooking the property's sprawling field. The interior features a 2-story walk-in atrium leading to vaulted ceilings, skylights and an open-concept main floor.  Living areas include a private primary suite with adjacent office and a cozy sunlight flex room with skylights and picture windows. A spacious main living room is ideal for entertaining with a floor-to-ceiling wood-burning fireplace to keep you cozy on winter nights. Extras also include a small deck ideal for grilling and a stone patio that overlooks the woodland valley below.   Three additional bedrooms include details like a walk-in closet and screened porch. The lower level includes a massive extra room for a gym or recreation area. Lower-level also includes ample storage room, laundry (washer & dryer included), and freezer.  Property is ideal for hiking, biking, and running enthusiasts and is 11 minutes from Metro-North commuter rail.
